description: Official vehicle type multipliers. All prices are calculated by multiplying the Car base rate by the vehicle multiplier. Car is the base unit (1.0x).

car.label: Car
car.description: Standard car. Base rate unit. Suitable for 1 to 3 passengers.

van.label: Van
van.description: Van or minivan. 1.5x the car base rate. Suitable for 4 to 6 passengers.

jeep.label: Jeep
jeep.description: Jeep or 4WD. 1.75x the car base rate. Suitable for 4 to 6 passengers. Recommended for hill and off-road routes.

hiace.label: Hiace
hiace.description: Toyota Hiace microbus. 1.75x the car base rate. Suitable for 7 to 14 passengers.

coaster.label: Coaster / Mini Bus
coaster.description: Coaster or mini bus. 2.5x the car base rate. Suitable for 15 to 25 passengers.

bus.label: Bus
bus.description: Full-size tourist bus. 3.0x the car base rate. Suitable for 25 to 35 passengers.

selection_guide: To recommend the right vehicle: 1-3 pax use Car, 4-6 pax use Van or Jeep, 7-14 pax use Hiace, 15-25 pax use Coaster, 25-35 pax use Bus. For hill or off-road routes always prefer Jeep over Van even for smaller groups.
